description: Convert blanks in each FILE to tabs, writing to standard output.

option.name: --all
tip: convert all blanks, instead of just initial blanks

option.name: --first-only
tip: convert only leading sequences of blanks (overrides -a)

option.name: --no-utf8
tip: interpret input file as 8-bit ASCII rather than UTF-8

option.name: --tabs
tip: use comma separated LIST of tab positions or have tabs N characters apart instead of 8 (enables -a)
